Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)

   where: /journal (GET /api/journal?q=...)
   expected: A malformed response is shown as a load error, not as search results
   saw: {"alerts":["14 entries match"],"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","14 entries match","–","–","–","–","–","–"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-172805-hunt-0b47/probes/plant-journal-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-search-malformed-not-shown-as-results")
2. HIGH   Plant journal section shows a malformed response as fake entries with Edit/Delete buttons
   where: /plants/:id Journal section (GET /api/journal?plant_id=...)
   expected: An error saying the journal could not load
   saw: {"seg":["Entries, newest first","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–","Edit","entry from –","Delete","entry from –","–"],"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-172805-hunt-0b47/probes/plant-journal-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-fault-malformed-shows-error")
3. HIGH   Plant journal shows an invalid (empty-object) response as 'No journal entries yet' while the badge counts entries
   where: /plants/:id Journal section
   expected: A visible load error
   saw: {"seg":["Entries, newest first","No journal entries yet","Note what you see: first shoots, pests, the weather.","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-172805-hunt-0b47/probes/plant-journal-faults.mjs (expectation "journal-fault-empty-object-shows-error")
4. MEDIUM No way to retry after the plant journal fails to load without reloading the page
   where: /plants/:id Journal section
   expected: A Retry button, or some other way to load the journal again once the fault clears
   saw: {"retryButtons":0,"text":"Journal\n2 entries\nNew entry\nDate\nEntry\n\n500 characters left\n\nAdd entry\nEntries, newest first\nInjected 500"}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-172805-hunt-0b47/probes/plant-journal-retry.mjs (expectation "journal-load-failure-offers-retry")
